Local safety-role flag can stop the model
Central-only actor cannot bypass local safety/recovery restart gate
One local role alone cannot satisfy joint restart
Both local roles restore only the healthy software model
Reconnection alone does not resume operations
Reconciliation retains local revocation; no actual ingestion service
Local export records remain until and after matching receipt, without claiming external durability
Named source/cohort/app can read the synthetic document
Unlisted user, issuer, app and admin action are denied by the local model
Source disablement blocks new model sign-in but does not magically revoke a resource session
Explicit resource-side denial removes the existing model session
Modeled separation denies fresh and old sessions and removes deployment binding
Expired sponsorship denies new model access at exactly 30 logical days

limitations: No network API, credential store, tenant, subscription, AD service or equipment is accessed.
HMAC key is ephemeral or an explicitly insecure fixture key; this is not production identity/cryptographic assurance.
Key/DNS/time/PKI/communications failures are input flags or logical values, not real services.
Logs are bounded in-memory hash-linked fixtures, not independently anchored, durable or tamper-proof storage.
Logical time is accelerated; no 24-hour endurance or real revocation latency was measured.
No physical actuation, hazard assessment, interlock or actual safe-state/restart was exercised.
Acquisition separation demonstrates only this local app/session model, not Entra or a deployed application.
